verdict.rationale: Trivy is a documented CLI that runs headlessly (`trivy image`, `trivy k8s --report summary`, `docker run aquasec/trivy`), and community users say it is very easy to automate and drop into CI/CD pipelines. Machine-readable output is evidenced only indirectly through CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM generation, and nothing shows filing issues from findings. Missing for 10: explicit JSON/SARIF vulnerability-report output for parsing, any issue-filing or triage integration, hands-on evidence of an agent-driven scan-to-issue workflow.
